provenance.source_title: POV You're the First Millionaire in Your Family's History.

examples.psychological_goal: 用一个家庭物件让观众瞬间认出整套传承
examples.expression_mechanism: 具体物件 + 先否定常规解释再给真因
examples.example_text: Your grandmother kept cash in a coffee can. Not because she didn't trust banks. She did.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用一个物件开场，并用"不是因为X。是Y"修正观众的第一猜测

examples.psychological_goal: 把贫困的传承机制压缩成一个时间错位句
examples.expression_mechanism: 时间错位（先于理解的羞耻）
examples.example_text: Money was a source of shame before you were old enough to understand what money was.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用"在你理解X之前，X已经是Y"的句式写深层的早期习得
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制 shame/money 的搭配

examples.psychological_goal: 把一个表情命名为人生最重要的课堂
examples.expression_mechanism: 微细节 + 教育重定义
examples.example_text: the look on their face when you asked was worse than not having the thing. That look taught you more than any classroom ever did.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用"那个X比Y更疼。那个X教你的比任何课堂都多"给微表情定价

examples.psychological_goal: 世界观裂缝：把差距从起点重写为决定
examples.expression_mechanism: 起点平权 + 决定论翻转
examples.example_text: These people didn't start with more than me. They just decided the ceiling wasn't real.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用"他们不是起点更高，只是认定X不存在"的句式完成信念翻转
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制 ceiling 的用法

examples.psychological_goal: 把圈层对野心的敌视机制化为免疫系统
examples.expression_mechanism: 生物隐喻 + 机制陈述
examples.example_text: Your circle has a very efficient immune system. It identifies ambition as a foreign body and attacks.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用"X有一套免疫系统，把Y识别为异物"解释群体对改变的排斥
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制 immune system 隐喻

examples.psychological_goal: 用账单隐喻预告后段所有失去
examples.expression_mechanism: 三句递进 + 财务隐喻
examples.example_text: Separation has a price. You haven't paid it yet. The invoice is coming.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用"X有代价。你还没付。账单在路上。"的三连句埋伏笔
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制 invoice 隐喻

examples.psychological_goal: 用反讽点名成功学产业，与高光叙事划清界限
examples.expression_mechanism: 排比点名 + 同词回环反讽（figuring it out）
examples.example_text: Every how I made my first million video. Every LinkedIn post from someone who figured it out and now sells courses about figuring it out.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用同词回环（弄明白了→卖"弄明白"的课）戳破一类话语的生意经
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制 LinkedIn 的点名方式

examples.psychological_goal: 让怀疑用最理性的声音说话，每个奋斗者的凌晨三点
examples.expression_mechanism: 怀疑之声的直接引语 + 两句升级
examples.example_text: Nobody from where you're from has done this. That's not a coincidence. That's data.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习让内心反对声音说"那不是巧合，是数据"——最强的怀疑披着逻辑的外衣

examples.psychological_goal: 把人生最高光时刻命名为一种失重的安静
examples.expression_mechanism: 反高潮命名（安静的定语堆叠）
examples.example_text: The profound, disorienting quiet of crossing a threshold that nobody in your bloodline has ever crossed.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用"那种深刻的、令人眩晕的安静"给巅峰体验降噪命名
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制 bloodline 的用法

examples.psychological_goal: 用一次没说出数字的通话写尽成功与亲情的错位
examples.expression_mechanism: 动作白描 + 关键缺席
examples.example_text: You want to call your mother. You dial. You talk for 20 minutes. You don't mention the number.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习列出全部动作（想打、拨了、聊了20分钟），让缺席的那个动作自己作响

examples.psychological_goal: 用放绳比喻写尽没有决裂的疏远
examples.expression_mechanism: 航海隐喻 + 副词堆叠（quietly, incrementally）
examples.example_text: Just a gradual drift. Like two boats that were once tied together and someone's quietly, incrementally letting out the rope.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用"两条曾系在一起的船，有人在一寸寸放绳"写无事件的关系流失
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制 boats/rope 隐喻

examples.psychological_goal: 把成功的愧疚具象为一张无法开出的支票
examples.expression_mechanism: 能力与前缀禁令的并置
examples.example_text: The guilt of watching your mother still worry about money when you could write a check that would end that worry forever
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用"你能用X终结Y，却不知如何不毁掉Z"的句式写能力的困局
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制 check/mother 的搭配

examples.psychological_goal: 把个人突破重构为世代工程，全片命题
examples.expression_mechanism: 对照判词（不只为自己打破，为后人移除）
examples.example_text: You don't just break the ceiling for yourself. You remove it entirely for everyone who comes after you.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用"你不只是为自己X，你为后来者Y"把个人成就升维
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制 ceiling 的搭配

examples.psychological_goal: 重定义一个被滥用的词：不是数字，是不同的起跑线
examples.example_text: That's what generational wealth actually is. It's not a number. It's a different starting line.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用"X其实是——不是数字，是另一种起点"为热词洗版
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制 starting line 的搭配

examples.psychological_goal: 空间隐喻翻面收束，用三个单词句给"成功后的风景"定调
examples.expression_mechanism: 隐喻翻面 + 三连短句
examples.example_text: You took the invisible ceiling and made it the floor. The view from here is nothing like you imagined. It's heavier. Quieter. More real.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习把开局的核心隐喻在结尾翻面，再用三个递进的单词句收束全片
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制 ceiling/floor 的翻面方式
